Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

Our project timeline has shifted by two weeks, and the new delivery date is 14 April. The change stems from the third-party integration we rely on, which needed longer to complete its certification process than the vendor originally anticipated. Our team has been in close contact with them throughout to keep the delay as short as possible.

In the meantime, all other workstreams remain on track, and we're using this window to run additional testing so the integration is fully validated once it clears certification. This should reduce the risk of further disruption later in the project and help ensure a smoother rollout when we reach the revised date.

Does 14 April still work with your internal plans, or are there dependencies on your end we should factor into the schedule? We'll follow up with a short status note as certification progresses, and we're happy to jump on a call if it would help to walk through the details.
